Dana, I haven't sent the email to Thea, and I haven't saved a draft either. Her address is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve it first. That rule covers drafts as well as sent mail. I've logged the approval request (pending), and Ruth will need to give her OK before I can send anything. Ruth isn't in this channel, so could you ping her, or ask her to reply here?

This is the summary I'd send, taken from #inc-qfl-sev1:

> The Superior dock schedule sync broke at about 6:40 AM (QFL local time) on 4 Nov 2025. Samir Patel's hotfix was deployed and the replay finished at 2:38 PM, after which all Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly in real time.

- **Start time:** the 6:40 AM figure is your own estimate from the channel, given in QFL's local time.
- **Hotfix time:** the 2:38 PM is the timestamp on Samir's message in the channel. I'm assuming that's our company time zone, so please check the two times line up before it goes out.

Once Ruth approves, I'll send it, or save it as a draft if you'd rather send it yourself.
